learning.title: A generated-file staleness check fails on a branch cut behind main, and the tempting fix adds a field no code reads
learning.trigger: A generated file is compared against a render of its declared source, the two disagree, and the check also fails on a clean tree at detached origin/main.
learning.mistake: Two mistakes, one root cause. First, committing the generated output of a source change while leaving the source behind, or editing a generated file by hand; both redden the base for every later branch, so the failure reads as the candidate's defect. Second, and worse, mis-diagnosing a staleness check as a real declaration/render mismatch and "curing" it by ADDING a field to the source. `docs/technical-design/transport-schemas.json` is a schema source that `contracts.ts` renders into generated TypeScript, so adding a `taskId` query parameter there makes the check green while advertising a parameter that `createExternalTicketsListHandler` never reads, has no SQL predicate for, and no test exercises. A spuriously advertised API field is a worse defect than the red it silences.
learning.rule: Read the failing FILE PATH before choosing a direction: these checks render two independent outputs from two independent sources, so the path names which side disagrees. `catalog-literals.ts` comes from `api-catalog.json`; `transport-schemas.ts` comes from `transport-schemas.json`. Then, for any field involved, find the code that READS it. The code is the truth: if nothing reads the field, the field is spurious, and adding it is not a cure. The cure is deciding which side is wrong by finding the reader, not by which direction turns the check green. When a branch cut before other merges sees behind-main generated files, the real cure is `git merge origin/main`, not a source edit. A fault that reproduces identically on detached origin/main belongs to the base or to staleness, never to the candidate: reproduce it before touching anything.

verification.command: git worktree add /tmp/wt-main-check origin/main --detach && cd /tmp/wt-main-check && pnpm catalog:literals:check
verification.requirement: The check passes on detached origin/main, and the candidate's render-vs-committed diff is empty after folding main. A candidate whose branch was cut behind main fails here only because of staleness; fold before diagnosing. A fix that turns the check green by adding generated lines is wrong whenever no production code reads the added field.
